description: (needs account token) Returns one file from a site you can update, as utf8 text or base64. site is the address. path is the file, such as index.html or css/site.css. A site token for that site works, including before the site is claimed, the same way an update with that token does. Without a token, claim the site first. Read-only. Does not charge.

path.description: The file, for example index.html or css/site.css.

site.description: The address of the site, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: get_site_file
title: Get site file
